title: Aromatic American Shrimp Skewers
description: Pungent and snappy, these shrimp skewers are a romantic American dish featuring cayenne pepper, perfect for a Mediterranean-friendly meal, served on a tagliere.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan-charcoal grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, black pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Add the shrimp to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Grill the shrimp skewers for 2-3 minutes per side, or until they are pink and cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately on a tagliere.
Serve with additional lemon wedges on the side, if desired.
Let the skewers rest for a minute or two before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
